name: Temporal Belief Dynamics in BERT
summary: Mapped how BERT's internal "beliefs" evolve across 10 fine-tuning epochs with graph-theoretic networks and 2D embeddings. Published at ICCIS 2025 (Springer LNCS).
highlights: Accepted at ICCIS 2025, BITS Pilani Goa (Springer LNCS)

name: ArsenicCure
kind: AI-powered arsenic skin lesion detection and severity grading
summary: Hybrid ResNet-18 + MobileNet-v2 + ViT model in PyTorch: 88.33% test accuracy, F1 0.88 on 3,462 skin lesion images across four severity classes.

name: Multimodal Cyberbullying Identification
kind: Advanced multimodal deep learning framework for proactive cyberbullying identification
summary: Multimodal model combining an LSTM for text with ResNet50 image features to predict cyberbullying behaviour, reaching 85% detection accuracy.
